rule: This register contains only closure objects judged necessary for a defensible Status-A assessment. It is not a wishlist and does not assign a new workunit number by default.

gaps.missing: Controlled WR-QA-2024 authority and explicit reconciliation against the public 22-row baseline.
gaps.partial: F-DOC01 pins WR-QA-2024 as project target and WR-QA-PUBLIC-22 as inspectable denominator, but records the controlled full text as NOT_OBTAINED.
gaps.why_insufficient: Without the controlled criterion text the project can perform readiness analysis but cannot make a formally defensible criterion-compliance claim.
gaps.minimal_closure: Obtain the controlled authority, pin provenance/version/numbering, reconcile every difference, and update only affected verdicts.
gaps.owner: SWAP model manager + WUR QA authority owner

gaps.missing: Admitted canonical bridge from physical world and modelling purpose through system of interest/boundary to reservoirs, states, fluxes, processes, assumptions and applicability.
gaps.partial: Target architecture and F-DOC12 describe boundaries/runtime composition; F-DOC16@b0bdf08b5c38771a4ee22c93ed0949f408ceeb2b is exact-head qualified branch-only closure input.
gaps.why_insufficient: Target architecture is not by itself scientific theory authority, and branch-only F-DOC16 has not been reconciled/admitted into the current authority chain.
gaps.minimal_closure: Reconcile and admit the valid F-DOC16 foundation content as the single normative conceptual owner, with explicit links to existing detailed process theory instead of rewriting it.

gaps.missing: Controlled formal physical chain for major physical capabilities: conservation laws, equations, constitutive relations, sources/sinks, IC/BC/interface conditions and bounded assumptions.
gaps.partial: F-DOC03-F-DOC13 provide strong lower-chain traceability; F-DOC11 explicitly keeps controlled T0-T7 gaps open; F-DOC13 closes only restricted TIME-REFERENCE numerics; F-DOC18@448265df8b5a4be8941b688bde378a490751c5f1 is candidate-only.
gaps.why_insufficient: Implementation and tests cannot serve as implicit theory authority. The candidate cannot close the gap until its science is reviewed and exact-head qualified/reconciled.
gaps.minimal_closure: Scientifically review the candidate T0-T7 content, disposition any ambiguity or theory-code mismatch through the proper scientific/implementation authority, then qualify and admit the accepted formal chain.

gaps.missing: Current technical/implementation overview reconciled to current-canonical snapshot eba90d..., including admitted post-RB1 F-CI49/F-CI50/F-CI50P state and executable environment/test index.
gaps.partial: Current F-CI authorities and CI evidence are strong; docs/architecture/implementation-status.md remains an older 2026-09-04 snapshot and target architecture is not an as-built status record.
gaps.why_insufficient: A reader cannot use a stale umbrella status page as exact current implementation evidence.
gaps.minimal_closure: Small documentation patch that updates the as-built status/reference links and technical environment/test index to the assessed SHA. Do not alter target architecture or physics.

gaps.missing: Canonical model-wide parameter, variable and I/O semantic reference with IDs, meaning, units, sign/time/spatial support, defaults/ranges where authoritative, applicability and version scope.
gaps.partial: Typed kernel/runtime contracts and F-DOC01 reference architecture exist; data categories are architecturally separated.
gaps.why_insufficient: The required model-wide assessment-facing reference is not yet established as a complete canonical object.
gaps.minimal_closure: Build or generate one reference layer from controlled schemas/authorities; keep legacy .swp mapping in adapters/reference documentation rather than making file syntax a kernel contract.

gaps.missing: Controlled provenance/preparation of relevant forcing/soil/crop inputs and explicit calibration procedure/effects or justified non-applicability by class.
gaps.partial: F-DOC01 defines provenance and calibration record expectations but intentionally creates no application evidence.
gaps.why_insufficient: Policy/schema is not evidence that actual inputs or calibration choices are traceable.
gaps.minimal_closure: Populate provenance and calibration/N-A records for the application classes used to support Status-A claims, tied to G5 stable identifiers.

gaps.missing: Decision-relevant sensitivity evidence and controlled uncertainty assessment for claimed application classes.
gaps.partial: F-DOC01 defines sensitivity/uncertainty/fitness schemas; numerical/interface sensitivities exist for solver/coupling purposes.
gaps.why_insufficient: Solver response derivatives and qualification perturbations are not a model/application sensitivity or uncertainty assessment.
gaps.minimal_closure: Run and interpret scoped sensitivity studies and at least the uncertainty assessment required by the reconciled criterion, with parameters/forcing/structural/numerical sources distinguished.

gaps.missing: Canonical external validation evidence for the application classes claimed, with independent observations/data/benchmarks, metrics, scales, provenance and explicit unvalidated scope.
gaps.partial: Verification, mass conservation, regression, restart, legacy identity and solver cross-check evidence are extensive.
gaps.why_insufficient: Those tests verify implementation/consistency but do not establish agreement with independent external reality.
gaps.minimal_closure: Qualify existing validation studies if suitable and provenance-complete; otherwise perform bounded validation. Never relabel verification as validation.
gaps.owner: SWAP scientific validation lead + domain/application owners

gaps.missing: Accepted monitored-use/application evidence and populated application-class fitness-for-purpose conclusions.
gaps.partial: Release nonclaims and F-DOC01 fitness architecture constrain overclaiming.
gaps.why_insufficient: Fitness cannot be inferred from a green solver/test suite; application use, validation, sensitivity/uncertainty and decision criteria must be connected.
gaps.minimal_closure: Use the reconciled criterion to define acceptable use-monitoring evidence, populate bounded application-class records, and state supported/unsupported uses.

gaps.missing: Required model metadata plus consolidated operational ownership/management, dependency/external-use/support records and user interpretation/operation guidance.
gaps.partial: Git/release governance, licensing/governance fragments, architecture/dependency information and developer documentation exist.
gaps.why_insufficient: The required records are fragmented and metadata format itself depends on controlled criterion reconciliation; user guidance cannot be complete before applicability/validation/uncertainty are populated.
gaps.minimal_closure: Populate the required metadata/management/dependency/external-use records and assemble user guidance from the now-canonical scientific and technical authorities. Prefer small patches and links over duplicated normative content.

deferred_post_status_a: Exhaustive line-by-line code-to-document traceability beyond representative scientific meaning and assessment needs.
Status-AA-specific closure beyond the reconciled Status-A denominator.
Broad documentation redesign where a thin canonical bridge plus links is sufficient.
Additional performance documentation or optimization not required by the Status-A criterion.
Additional coupling capabilities such as full production predictor-corrector/MODFLOW execution unless needed for a claimed application class.

closure_order.formal_assessment_gate: Re-evaluate every reconciled official criterion against one exact immutable release or named current-canonical candidate SHA.
